grn.fitting_source: base TF dictionary across all cells

tests.scope: Plotting risk guards: existing output preservation, cell/gene axis order, nonfinite and inconsistent deltas, shared-coordinate integrity, target exclusion and signed selection, GRN roundoff versus material differences. Small unit fixtures are not used as case data.

scientific_limitations: Network simulation on a 500-cell single-mouse demonstration subset, not observed Gata1 perturbation data or independent biological validation.
One GRN across the selected cells; no trusted cell-type or trajectory annotation is used.
Excluding 2109 ambiguous multi-name gene rows removes 284322 / 2149673 counts in selected cells.
The fixed OE P95 setting raises 475 and lowers 25 target-gene baselines; it is not a uniform fold-change.
delta_X is on the CellOracle internal imputed log1p(raw-count) scale and must not be called measured log2FC.
Single randomized delta_X projection is a descriptive reference on the fitted GRN, not a randomized GRN or significance test.
Some optional external motif-discovery tools are absent; this run imports a pinned promoter prior and never executes de novo motif discovery.
